title: On March 28 Let’s Say “No Kings” and “No Nukes”
author: Karl Grossman - Harvey Wasserman
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/mohamed-nohassi-
r_Tuz7-tfdM-unsplash-680x383.jpg)

Image by Mohamed Nohassi.

This March 28, 2026, millions of pro-democracy “No Kings” marchers should also
demand “No Nukes” in the wake of March 28, 1979’s meltdown at the Three Mile
Island nuclear power plant.

While a cluster of Democratic governors push restarts of deadly old nuclear
power plants like TMI and Michigan’s Palisades, King Donald also wants to
restart nuclear weapons testing.

The “No Kings” challenge to Trump’s oligarchic threat to democracy, joined
with the “No Nukes” demand for a Solartopian Earth—totally green-powered, no
nuclear plants, no atomic weapons—will create an epic moment for the human
future.

Trump is the first U.S. president to fire a chairman of the five-member
Nuclear Regulatory Commission. The NRC was originally entrusted to oversee the
94 U.S. commercial nukes. Now Trump reigns supreme over atomic reactor safety.
It’s a terrifying reality.

Meanwhile, his Royal Crime Family has become directly involved financially in
the latest “nuclear renaissance,” with merger of the Trump Media & Technology
group, in a $6 billion [deal](https://tae.com/trump-media-and-technology-
group-to-merge-with-tae-technologies), with the California-based fusion energy
company TAE Technologies.

Amidst this royal conflict of interest, the Trump White House has issued a
stream of executive orders decimating the “regulation” of nuclear power
plants, fission and fusion, small and large, present and future.

Along with California’s self-proclaimed “green” Governor Gavin Newsom, Trump
is also attacking renewable energy, including solar and wind, batteries and
geothermal.

Trump further demands a massive build-up of nuclear weaponry recklessly
trashing the fragile global network of agreements meant to shrink our suicidal
atomic arsenals.

To better serve his billionaire reactor backers, Trump has unleashed a barrage
of “revised” safety regulations that shred already lax health protections. His
fiats multiply the “peaceful atoms” pouring into the bodies of downwind
neighbors and on-site workers.

Elon Musk’s DOGE has long since purged the NRC’s already thin technical safety
staff.

A half-century ago, Dr. John Gofman, first health/safety chief of the original
Atomic Energy Commission, predecessor of the NRC, warned that the U.S. reactor
fleet (then much smaller than today’s) could every year be fatally irradiating
some 32,000 downwind civilians downwind, along with still more on-site staff.

After his involvement in the Manhattan Project that built the atomic bomb,
Gofman spent the rest of his career warning against the massive health impacts
of a technology he helped birth.

Trump’s regal decrees now guarantee a vastly escalated death toll. The DOGE
bloodbath leaves the already weak NRC virtually powerless to maintain sound
operations at the decrepit U.S. nuclear power plant fleet.

Trump’s firing of an NRC chair and slashing of existing safety standards feed
the radioactive cash flow for Trump and his fellow oligarchs. They signal that
any NRC employee daring to accurately report on reactor defects and dangers
will be ignored and fired.

Even before Trump, the NRC trashed Dr. Michael Peck, its own resident site
inspector at the Diablo Canyon double-nuke site in coastal California. During
his five-year on-site posting, Dr. Peck warned that Diablo might not survive a
seismic shock from one or more of the dozen fault lines surrounding the plant,
sending radioactive clouds into downwind Los Angeles and over much of the rest
of North America.

Dr. Peck was soon gone. The NRC remains officially unconcerned.

California’s Democrat Governor Gavin Newsom, now selling himself as the anti-
Trump, is following Trump’s pro-nuclear lead. In 2018 Newsom (then lieutenant
governor) signed a consensus master plan phasing out Diablo for a transition
to renewables. The deal was embraced by the utility, the legislature,
regulatory agencies, unions, local governments, environmental/consumer groups
and more.

Two million solarized rooftops sped the state toward vastly lowered electric
rates. Advanced battery storage now guarantees against grid blackouts. For
much of most days, the state gets 100% of its electricity from renewables.

But in 2022, Newsom aborted the full transition. His assault on California
rooftop solar industry has killed thousands of jobs. He’s moved to let the
Diablo’s reactors run at least through 2030.

Like all atomic reactors, they emit massive quantities of heat, greenhouse
gasses and deadly radiation. They operate in direct violation of state and
federal clean water regulations, none of which Trump or Newsom are likely to
enforce.

Diablo’s soaring operating costs, and Newsom’s Trump-like attack on rooftop
solar make California’s utility rates the highest in the continental U.S.

Of four big new U.S. reactors been ordered in this century, two in South
Carolina died outright, at a sunk cost of $9 billion. Two in Georgia came in
seven years late, at $35+ billion, twice their original promised price,
producing electricity way more expensive than renewables.

But a pack of Democrats still join Trump to push so-called Small Modular
Reactors, their only operating model is in China. Specialized SMR fuel right
now comes only from Russia. The first U.S. SMR order has died. Projected SMR
costs are now 3 times over proven wind, solar, geothermal and battery storage,
none of which create radioactive emissions or waste.

A definitive [study](https://www.cato.org/regulation/fall-2025/next-nuclear-
renaissance) from the free market CATO Institute predicts that SMRs—indeed the
entire latest “nuclear renaissance”—will be buried (again) by far cheaper,
cleaner, faster-to-build Solartopian technologies.

Trump royally claims that ultra-hyped data and AI centers will provide their
own power. But Democratic Governors Newsom, Hochul (N.Y.), Pritzker (IL),
Shapiro (PA), Whitmer (MI) all falsely claim public-funded nukes to run them
will be “emission-free” and somehow safe, despite Trump’s self-dealing
regulatory exemption and the lack of meaningful insurance.

Whitmer and Shapiro want to restart dead reactors at TMI and Palisades despite
terrifying technical pitfalls and projected costs and delivery times very far
beyond renewables. Hochul has just arranged for four aged nuclear power plants
in New York—including the oldest in the nation, Nine Mile Point l—to continue
to run through a subsidy of $33.3 billion paid for over 20 years by all the
state’s electric ratepayers on their electric bills.

Too many regular Democrats still falsely claim that nukes are safe and
carbon/emission free, as if TMI, Chernobyl and Fukushima never happened. They
won’t face that renewables are exponentially cheaper, faster to build, more
reliable and produce more jobs.

Meanwhile Trump’s parallel push for new atomic and hydrogen bombs, with a
return to testing of nuclear weapons, stands to trigger a renewed global
nuclear arms race and the spectre of not only an end to democracy but to our
species’ survival on this planet.

On March 28, 1979, unmeasured radiation
[spewed](https://ratical.org/radiation/KillingOurOwn/) into the Pennsylvania
countryside, killing untold American citizens.

On March 28, 2026, let’s join forces to protect our shredded democracy in the
face of a deranged psychopath who would rule as a king alongside his
billionaire oligarchs.

Let’s also march to abolish the atomic reactors and their sibling weapons that
threaten our ecological and biological existence.

And let’s win a Solartopian economy—rooted in solar photovoltaics, wind,
geothermal, batteries, efficiency, conservation and the other nature-based
technologies we need to survive and thrive on this planet.

On March 28, let’s all be out there…everywhere….smiling, dancing, marching,
laughing, WINNING!!…for NO KINGS & NO NUKES!!
